# `hk agent mcp`

- **How to hail it:** `hk agent mcp <--target <TARGET>>`
- **Effect:** read-only (looks, never touches)

Print an MCP server configuration, matey

## Flags to fly {#flags}

- **`--target <TARGET>`** — The MCP host to write the server configuration for

  **Choose from:** `codex`, `claude-desktop`, `claude-code`, `vscode`

- **`-h --help`** — Print help, for when ye've lost yer bearings

<!-- hk documentation examples -->

## Tales from the deck {#examples}

Print an MCP configuration for yer host, then look over its project path so it points at the right ship.

```sh
hk agent mcp --target codex
hk agent mcp --target claude-desktop
```
